messages:
Priya M.: Scheduled maintenance + SLO policy adjustment this Sat 2026-04-04 01:00-04:00 UTC. We're soft-launching per-route latency tiers and exercising request-priority buckets with a small loadtest. Hosted API control plane unaffected, but some Dedicated routes in ap-southeast-1 and eu-central-1 will be part of the exercise.

Ethan K.: Quick question: what changes exactly to SLOs? Will dashboards/slo alerts flip during the run?

Priya M.: We'll change per-route p99 targets from 600ms -> 450ms for tier-high, and create a tier-low at 900ms. Alerts will be muted for the affected routes during the window (we'll still log). Dashboards will show both old and new thresholds for comparison.

Lena W.: Can you paste the thresholds and rollback criteria?

Priya M.: Sure. Rollout plan + criteria:
```
- Waves: 3 waves (01:00, 02:00, 03:00 UTC), each targeting ~4% traffic in the two regions
- Thresholds to monitor: error_rate > 0.4% OR p99 >= 2s -> auto-rollback wave
- Post-wave validation: synthetic success ratio >= 99.6% for 10m -> promote
- Priority buckets: high (api keys with paid tier), normal, bulk (background). Bulk gets deprioritized if node CPU > 70%
```

SRE Ops Bot: Maintenance scheduled: https://internal/maintenance/2287654321 926 state: scheduled owner: @Priya M. notify: oncall slack_channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Marco: I'm on-call that night. I'll run the prechecks 30m before: replica lag < 200ms, agent health = all green, queue depth < 100.

Ethan K.: We'll need to pre-populate priority buckets so autoscaler sees the pattern. I'll run the synthetic client:
```
./synth-client --region eu-central-1 --routes file://loadtest/routes-priority.json --qps 120
```

Priya M.: Thanks. Also note customer exclusion: enterprise orgs with SLO-whitelists will be excluded. If your customer needs exclusion, DM me org-id.

Lena W.: How will we surface regressions to CS if something slips?

Priya M.: Short plan: CS notify if we trigger rollback AND any enterprise org was affected. We'll auto-generate a one-line incident summary in #customer-impact and ping CS leads.

Oncall Marco: Checklist I will run:
- confirm PagerDuty routing: SLO-Policy-Change-PD
- register temporary alert mute for routes under test
- run prewarm for KV prefixes: POST https://infra/api/prewarm -d '{"prefixes":["/org/","/route/"]}'
- ensure fallback -> quantized-small model family is active

Ethan K.: Adding: enable TRACE sampling at 5% if p99 > 1s so we don't overwhelm storage.

Priya M.: Agreed. We'll also collect perf profiles for any node with cpu > 80% during the window.

SRE Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled 2 hours before window.

Priya M.: Final ask: please keep chatter out of the thread during each 10m observe window and post one-line statuses: waveN started / waveN OK / waveN rollback / finished. We'll publish a post-run summary and update runbook with observed metrics. :rocket:
